subject: literacy
concept: Segmenting a spoken word into its individual sounds
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading phonemic awareness sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student pulls apart sound tiles one at a time while saying each sound in a word
exercise.pictorial: Student fills empty sound-boxes with the correct number of markers for a spoken word
exercise.abstract: Student says each individual sound in a spoken word, in order

misconception_flags: merges two sounds together instead of separating them
misses the final sound in a word

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
